run_benchmark_model: run a benchmark on an MMDet3D model using a config file and checkpoint to measure inference FPS
run_benchmark_with_fused_bn: run a benchmark on an MMDet3D model with fused conv and batch norm for faster inference speed
run_benchmark_custom_samples: run a benchmark on an MMDet3D model with a custom number of samples and log interval
parse_args_benchmark: parse command line arguments for the MMDet3D benchmark tool including config, checkpoint, and options
main_benchmark: execute the main benchmark loop that loads a model, runs inference on samples, and reports FPS
